# MoSheet

The phone bottom sheet: 28pt top corners, a grabber and an optional title row, for secondary choices.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoSheet` · 14 Phone

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoSheet onClose={…}>…</OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoSheet>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoSheet" on-close="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Bottom sheet: 28pt top corners, 36 × 5 grabber, optional title row with a close button, scrim tap closes. Thread menu, attach + model + effort, search, new delegation. On Expo it renders in a Modal; pass visible. @startingPoint section="Phone" subtitle="Bottom sheet" viewport="860x560"

| `title` | `string` |  |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  |
| `full` | `boolean` | Stops just below the top instead of hugging its content. |
